metadata.title: On the tangent flows of noncollapsed Ricci flow limit spaces
metadata.abstract: We study tangent flows of noncollapsed Ricci flow limit spaces in the sense of Fang-Li. We prove that the regular part of every negative time slice is geodesically convex: any minimizing geodesic that meets the regular part has its entire interior contained in it. We also identify each negative time slice with the metric completion of its regular Riemannian part, thereby identifying the negative-time tangent flow with its associated metric soliton.

analysis.topic: 几何分析、几何 PDE 与几何流
analysis.progressType: 非塌缩 Ricci 流切流的负时间几何
analysis.workSummary: 证明 Fang–Li limit space 切流每个负时间片的 regular part 测地凸，并识别全时间片为其黎曼 regular part 的度量完备化，从而与 associated metric soliton 一致。
analysis.breakthrough: 消除负时间片 regular geometry 与整体度量之间的识别缺口。
analysis.limitations: 结论只覆盖负时间片，不能无条件延伸到时间零。
analysis.aiEvidence: 作者披露 ChatGPT 辅助草拟、数学表述、修订、引用检查及制图；数学想法来自作者，主要技术来自既有工作。
analysis.aiEvidenceSource: https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.05204v1 · PDF 第 5 页，AI declaration
